title: ASCEP Layer 2 — Model declaration
description: Layer 2 of the five ASCEP layers. Declares weights, precision, and KV geometry. The distinction total_params vs active_params is normative: weight_bytes uses total_params, roofline_decode_tok_s uses active_params — confusing them is the most common cause of a spurious roofline efficiency near 1.0.

model_id.description: Canonical model identifier (registry ID or repository path).

revision.description: Revision, commit, or content digest. Weights change silently within a model ID; without a revision the report cannot be reproduced (C8).

total_params.description: Total parameters, counting every expert of an MoE (all experts must be resident). Units: dimensionless count. Input to ascep.capacity.weight_bytes. Using active params here undercounts resident memory by up to 1/top_k.

total_params_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when total_params is null (C1).

active_params.description: Per-token active parameters: dense = total_params; MoE = shared trunk + top_k experts. Units: dimensionless count. Input ONLY to compute models (ascep.capacity.roofline_decode_tok_s, roofline_prefill_ttft_s), never to memory models.

active_params_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when active_params is null (C1).

architecture.description: dense / MoE. If 'moe', moe_experts and moe_top_k MUST be set.

moe_experts.description: Number of routed experts (MoE only; null for dense with moe note not required).

weight_precision.description: Stored weight element type; MUST be a key of ascep.capacity.DTYPE_BYTES (fp32, tf32, fp16, bf16, fp8, int8, fp6, nvfp4, mxfp4, int4, fp4). Quantization scales/zero-points are expressed via weight_overhead_frac.

weight_overhead_frac.description: Fractional overhead for quantization scales/zero-points/padding, dimensionless. Passed to ascep.capacity.weight_bytes(overhead_frac=...).

kv_precision.description: KV cache element type; MUST be a key of ascep.capacity.DTYPE_BYTES. Distinct from weight_precision: KV quantization changes both capacity and quality and MUST be declared independently.

n_layers.description: Transformer layer count. Input to ascep.capacity.kv_bytes_per_token.

n_layers_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when n_layers is null (C1).

n_kv_heads.description: KV heads (not attention heads). Input to ascep.capacity.kv_heads_per_rank; when tensor_parallel exceeds this, heads are replicated and KV capacity falls — a wrong value here produces a per-GPU KV figure that is unusable at other TP widths (C3).

n_kv_heads_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when n_kv_heads is null (C1).

head_dim.description: Per-head hidden dimension. Input to ascep.capacity.kv_bytes_per_token.

head_dim_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when head_dim is null (C1).

attention_type.description: Attention pattern. This field selects WHICH KV formula applies and is therefore one of the highest-leverage declarations in the protocol. full/gqa/mqa/sliding-window/hybrid use ascep.capacity.kv_bytes_per_token and require n_kv_heads and head_dim. 'mla' (multi-head latent attention, DeepSeek-style) uses kv_bytes_per_token_mla and requires kv_lora_rank and qk_rope_head_dim instead: its latent is replicated across tensor-parallel ranks rather than sharded, and applying the gqa formula to it overstates KV by ~57x. linear/ssm/hybrid-recurrent keep a fixed-size state per sequence rather than per token and require kv_bytes_per_sequence; modelling them per-token predicts a long-context cliff that does not exist. Sliding-window and hybrid MUST also set global_layer_frac.

global_layer_frac.description: Fraction of layers holding full-length KV, n_global_layers / n_layers; 1.0 for uniform full attention. Input to ascep.capacity.kv_bytes_per_token. Report the value used — it moves KV capacity by several times and is a common source of analytic/measured disagreement (see calibrate_memory_utilization).

global_layer_frac_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when global_layer_frac is null (C1).

native_max_context_tokens.description: Native maximum context length in tokens. Serving max_model_len MUST NOT exceed this without declaration.

native_max_context_tokens_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when native_max_context_tokens is null (C1).

weight_bytes_on_disk.description: Measured resident weight bytes (M); tag MUST be 'M'. The protocol prefers this over ascep.capacity.weight_bytes when both exist. Units: bytes.

weight_bytes_on_disk_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when weight_bytes_on_disk is null (C1).

weight_bytes_tag.description: Provenance tag for weight_bytes_on_disk (C2); 'T' is not meaningful for weights.

licence.description: Licence identifier (SPDX preferred). Capacity without licence context is not procurement-actionable.

kv_lora_rank.description: MLA only. Rank of the compressed KV latent, verbatim from config.json (DeepSeek-V3: 512). Units: dimensionless. Input to ascep.capacity.kv_bytes_per_token_mla.

qk_rope_head_dim.description: MLA only. Dimension of the decoupled RoPE key, verbatim from config.json (DeepSeek-V3: 64). Units: dimensionless. Input to ascep.capacity.kv_bytes_per_token_mla.

kv_bytes_per_sequence.description: linear/ssm/hybrid-recurrent only. Fixed recurrent state per sequence, independent of context length. Units: bytes. Input to ascep.capacity.kv_capacity_sessions. Hybrid stacks set this AND the per-token geometry; the costs add.

model_id_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when model_id is null (C1).

revision_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when revision is null (C1).

architecture_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when architecture is null (C1).

moe_experts_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when moe_experts is null (C1).

moe_top_k_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when moe_top_k is null (C1).

weight_precision_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when weight_precision is null (C1).

weight_overhead_frac_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when weight_overhead_frac is null (C1).

kv_precision_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when kv_precision is null (C1).

attention_type_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when attention_type is null (C1).

weight_bytes_tag_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when weight_bytes_tag is null (C1).

licence_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when licence is null (C1).

kv_lora_rank_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when kv_lora_rank is null (C1).

qk_rope_head_dim_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when qk_rope_head_dim is null (C1).

kv_bytes_per_sequence_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when kv_bytes_per_sequence is null (C1).

sliding_window_tokens.description: Attention window in tokens for sliding-window layers. KV for those layers stops growing past this length, so a model served beyond its window has a flat KV floor that the token-linear formula would overstate.

sliding_window_tokens_u_reason.description: (U) justification required when sliding_window_tokens is null (C1).
